title: Nonzero codes and position bit assignments
statement: For natural numbers $w$ and $i$, the canonical switching block codes on $w$ positions whose position sets have cardinality $i$ and whose bits are not all zero on that set are in bijection with pairs consisting of an $i$-element subset of $	ext{Fin}(w)$ and a nonzero bit assignment on that subset.
